tasks.q_en: Hagrid has always dreamed of a dragon, and now he has an egg, won at cards from a stranger in a pub. Keeping dragons is against the law! You watch Norbert hatch, grow bigger every day, and Malfoy spy through the window.

tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: used to + verb = past habits/states that are no longer true: Hagrid used to live alone. He used to dream of a dragon. would + verb = repeated past actions (not states): Every evening he would sing to Norbert. Don't confuse: be used to + -ing/noun (be accustomed) and get used to + -ing/noun (become accustomed): I'm used to the smell. I'm getting used to it.
